profile_text.body:
Google's Gemini site describes Gemini as Google's AI assistant, offering help with writing, planning, and brainstorming, and presenting it as generative AI. The company profile lists Google as a public company founded in 1998, headquartered in Mountain View, CA, USA, trading under the ticker GOOGL with CIK 0001652044. Its most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting revenue of $402,836,000,000.

Products associated with Google include Gemini, described as a general LLM assistant; Google AI Studio for model prototyping; Google Med-PaLM / MedLM, a medical LLM noted for clinical reasoning and healthcare data, with a HIPAA BAA required and diagnostic liability noted; Google Drive AI, described as cloud storage AI with Gemini integration, Workspace data, and sharing governance; Google Meet AI for meeting summaries, live captions, and note-taking; NotebookLM for document grounding that ingests uploaded corpora; and TensorFlow / Keras, an ML framework noted for model serialization risks, custom model governance, and TensorFlow Extended (TFX) for MLOps.

MCP servers associated with Google cover Google Ads reporting and campaign management, Google News search, Google Search Console rankings and indexing, Google OAuth credential and sign-in agents, Google Forms, Google Calendar, and Google Trends search interest. These are listed under providers including ai.adplane, ai.adramp, ai.b77, ai.getvda, ai.smithery, and ai.trendsapi. Google's recorded law exposure in California stands at 281 cases.
